title: ALL IN BOXING
intro:
Quan Ju De (拳锯德) is an original AIGC IP I created in October 2025, blending boxing culture, visual storytelling, and generative technology. At its heart—literally—is a boxing glove fused with a chainsaw, capturing passion, resilience, and a playful edge.

Every image and video in this collection is AI-generated, expanding the character into a growing visual universe where creative direction meets experimentation—and boxing gets a little more imaginative.
